title: My ML model predicted the BTC drop. Closed with ~9,700 points in profit.
author: Public_Luck_4753
selftext:
​

Hey guys,

Finally, a solid result to share!

The SHORT signal generated by my ML model on 10 November and closed on 14 November 23:59:59, delivered **9,700 points in net profit.**

**Entry:** 73,800  

**Exit:** 64,150

I've attached the chart showing the complete move.

What makes this trade particularly satisfying is that the model identified the bearish direction ahead of the drop. After a few trades that didn't go as expected before, this is a good reminder of why I believe in sticking with a backtested system rather than judging its performance based on a handful of outcomes.

For those who don't know, I've been working on this BTC prediction model for several years now. It's a machine learning-based system that analyses market data and generates predictions for the next 5 days, along with probability estimates showing how likely BTC is to move bullish or bearish.

What makes it interesting is that the model isn't built around a fixed set of rules or indicators. It keeps learning from incoming market data and adapts to changing market conditions, so it's not simply relying on the same parameters all the time.

The whole idea behind building it was to develop something that could recognise market patterns, learn from data and provide an objective view of where BTC might be heading over the next few days.

I'm open to conversations with people interested in acquiring the system cause due to capital limitations I am unable to scale it at its desired level that's why the possible solution is allowing someone who is genuinely interested in the system to acquire it. I have years of backtested data, a full year of real trading data and also 4 months of MT5 account data which is accessible to verify the results.

Feel free to reach out if you're genuinely interested.
